versions.message: Invoice while packing; customers can cancel during validation
versions.author: Ana
versions.source:
---
title: Order lifecycle
---
stateDiagram-v2
  accTitle: Order lifecycle
  accDescr: An order from the cart to delivery, with payment and courier booking in parallel and packing while it is invoiced
  state "Shopping cart" as Cart
  Cart : items and totals
  Cart : editable by the customer
  state split <<fork>>
  state merge <<join>>
  [*] --> Cart
  Cart --> Validation : checkout
  state Validation {
    state stock <<choice>>
    [*] --> Checking
    Checking --> stock
    stock --> Reserved : in stock
    stock --> Backordered : out of stock
    Backordered --> Reserved : restocked
    Reserved --> [*]
  }
  Validation --> split
  split --> Payment
  split --> Courier
  Payment --> merge
  Courier --> merge
  merge --> Fulfilment
  state Fulfilment {
    [*] --> Picking
    Picking --> Packed
    Packed --> [*]
    --
    [*] --> Invoicing
    Invoicing --> Invoiced
    Invoiced --> [*]
  }
  Fulfilment --> Shipped : handed over
  Shipped --> Delivered
  Delivered --> [*]
  Validation --> Cancelled : customer cancels
  Cancelled --> [*]
  note right of Cart : prices are locked at checkout
  note left of Shipped
    tracking number
    sent by e-mail
  end note
  classDef problem fill:#fde8ec,stroke:#d0312d
  class Backordered, Cancelled problem

%%@ canvas {"v":1}
%%@ node Delivered {"preset":"done"}
%%@ node Payment {"preset":"active"}
%%@ node Courier {"preset":"active"}
%%@ edge Validation->Cancelled {"preset":"error"}
